statement: ECB, T2S opening hours: 'T2S is open from Monday to Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday. For euro settlement, T2S is also closed on: 1 January (New Year's Day) Good Friday Easter Monday 1 May (Labour Day) 25 December (Christmas Day) 26 December (Boxing Day)'. The ECB states a rule, not dated lists; the dates below expand it for 2026-2032, the years for which the Good Friday and Easter Monday dates were cross-checked against a published table (Deutsche Boerse).

sources.covers: CSDs connected to T2S include Clearstream Banking AG (Germany), Euroclear Belgium, Euroclear France, Euroclear Netherlands, EuroNext Securities Milan (Italy), EuroNext Securities Porto (Portugal), Iberclear - BME Group (Spain)
Good Friday and Easter Monday dates 2026-2032; 'No trading but settlement is open' on 24 and 31 December (consistent with T2S)
CSDR Art. 2(1)(14): 'business day' means business day as defined in point (n) of Article 2 of Directive 98/26/EC (the settlement system's business day)

notes: Settlement calendar for euro settlement in T2S. Used for XETR, XPAR, XAMS, XBRU, XLIS, XMIL and XMAD trades on the assumption that each venue's domestic shares settle at a CSD connected to T2S (the ECB list above); CSD-specific closing days, if any, are not verified.
Closing days that fall on a weekend are listed anyway; they do not change business-day arithmetic.
Not used for trading: Xetra and Borsa Italiana do not trade on 24 and 31 December, but T2S settles on those days.
